description:
Analyze the user's stock portfolio.

    Returns concentration risk (low/medium/high), a diversification
    score (0-10), a sector breakdown (looking through known ETFs), the
    biggest winner and loser by dollar impact, and a short written
    summary. Use this when the user asks how diversified, concentrated or
    risky their portfolio is. Don't use it just to list holdings (use
    list_portfolio).

    Limits: requires sign-in. Prices can be up to 7 days old; positions
    without a price are labeled, never guessed.
    Educational information, not investment advice.
name: analyze_portfolio
title: Analyze My Portfolio
